name: Meta-INR
definition: A method reducing training cost for time-varying INRs by applying MAML to pretrain a shared parameter set on a spatiotemporally subsampled subset, followed by per-volume finetuning.
summary: Meta-INR is a meta-learning pretraining strategy for Implicit Neural Representations that optimizes shared initialization parameters to enable rapid few-shot adaptation to new volumes, significantly reducing encoding time compared to training from scratch.
